001package org.clafer.ast;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.clafer.common.Check;
005
006/**
007 * A constant set.
008 *
009 * @author jimmy
010 */
011public record AstConstant(ProductType type, int[]... value) implements AstSetExpr {
012
013    public AstConstant {
014        Check.notNull(type);
015        Check.notNull(value);
016        if (type.arity() != value.length) {
017            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
018        }
019    }
020
021    @Override
022    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
023        return obj instanceof AstConstant other
024                && type.equals(other.type) && Arrays.deepEquals(value, other.value);
025    }
026
027    @Override
028    public int hashCode() {
029        return type.hashCode() ^ Arrays.deepHashCode(value);
030    }
031
032    @Override
033    public String toString() {
034        if (value[0].length == 0) {
035            return "[]";
036        }
037        if (type.isInt()) {
038            return Integer.toString(value[0][0]);
039        }
040        return Arrays.deepToString(value) + "::" + type;
041    }
042}
